text: タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ないけどな

structure.jp: タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ないけどな
structure.en: not as much as Brock, though

patterns.name: 〜ほど〜ない
patterns.span: タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ない
patterns.explanation: ほど with a 'not' after it says something does not reach the level of the thing named. タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ない = 'not as much as Brock'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence adds a soft 'though', and な makes it sound like the speaker is musing to himself. ないけどな = 'it isn't, though'.
